messages:
aisha.finance: Hey team — AcmeMed private renewal hit my desk. They asked to drop from Enterprise Support -> Standard at renewal, and want the excess platform fee for the unused months credited. Invoice 84721 included platform fee proration but shows no credit. Can ops / billing confirm?
leo.revops: @aisha.finance I pulled the renewal: original commitment had 12 mo Enterprise support add-on ($60k) + monthly platform fee $10k. They submitted a signed amendment on 2345672000 reducing support to Standard starting on renewal date. Did sales create an amendment SOW? :thinking_face:
sam.cs: We have the signed amendment (SOW-ACM-2026-03) but it looks like Sales marked it as 'effective on next billing cycle' — that should've applied. Customer expects pro-rated credit for the remaining 8 months of the Enterprise support add-on.
trent.partnerops: Also FYI vendor invoice from RackEdge (HSM appliances) was in the same bundle and shows as pass-through on the quote — vendor billed earlier than expected. This might be why the platform fee line aligned to full-year. Attached doc in SF.
billing-bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-2026-84721 (2345678910) — total $170,000. Line items: `platform_fee: $120,000`, `enterprise_support_addon: $60,000`, `hardware_pass_through: -$10,000`.
aisha.finance: That `hardware_pass_through` negative is weird — should be +$10k expense, not negative. Can someone confirm GL mapping? We need to invoice customer correctly and not eat pass-through.
leo.revops: Looks like mapping bug: pass-through got inverted when imported. I'll open a ticket with engineering to flip the sign for vendor pass-throughs. In the meantime we need a manual credit memo so customer sees the support pro-rate and correct hardware charge. 
sam.cs: Proposed calc: Enterprise addon $60k / 12 = $5k/mo. They moved to Standard at renewal (after 4 months) so remaining 8 months -> credit $40k. Platform fee: customer was billed full $120k annual; since they're staying on platform, no platform fee credit, but they want the Enterprise delta removed. 
aisha.finance: Agreed. So total customer credit = $40k. But because vendor pass-through was mis-coded as -$10k, ledger currently shows $130k revenue. Adjusting will change revenue by +10k — we need GL code and PO for vendor to avoid mismatch.
trent.partnerops: Vendor PO is PO-99321, vendor invoice INV-RACK-55. I confirm vendor expects payment and that $10k should be an expense. I'll route a PO correction to procurement.
leo.revops: Quick ask for approvals: can FP&A approve a one-time credit memo of $40k and a manual adj to flip the vendor pass-through sign? This will affect Q2 revenue recognition.
aisha.finance: @marco.fpa can you weigh in? Marco's take will determine whether we net the vendor correction against the credit memo or book separate adjustments.
marco.fpa: OK — I reviewed. Approve issuing credit memo CM-2345 for $40,000 to AcmeMed. For the vendor pass-through fix, booking a contra-revenue adjustment is acceptable this quarter, but we need a reconciliation entry with PO-99321 and send reversal to AR. Please add a memo referencing INV-2026-84721 and CM-2345.
sam.cs: Thanks Marco. Who will create the CM and the GL reversing entry? 
leo.revops: I'll create the revenue reversal journal and assign to Heather on billing ops to issue CM-2345. Heather FYI — can you create the credit and update Stripe/AR? :eyes:
heather.billing: Got it — creating CM-2345 and will update AR today. Will also attach PO-99321 to the journal entry. ETA EOD.
aisha.finance: Great. One more: customer requested waiver of the late payment penalty that was applied to INV-2026-84721 because of the billing confusion. Can we do that?
marco.fpa: Waive late fee. Document in the memo. 
trent.partnerops: I'll update the partner/vendor thread so they expect corrected PO and payment flow.
aisha.finance: Thanks all — please leave a short note when complete. I’ll close the renewal ticket after CM is issued. :white_check_mark:
heather.billing: CM-2345 created, AR adjusted, vendor pass-through sign corrected in ledger, PO attached. Closing ticket.
leo.revops: Confirmed ledger fix and revenue reversal posted (JE-2026-778). Q2 projection updated.
aisha.finance: Closing thread — thanks everyone. :tada:
